orders.q1: How do I place an order?
orders.a1: Browse our Shop or Collections, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You'll be directed to our secure Shopify-powered checkout to complete your purchase.
orders.q2: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?
orders.a2: Orders can often be modified or cancelled within a short window after placement. Please contact us via WhatsApp or email as soon as possible and we'll do our best to help.
orders.q3: Do I need an account to order?
orders.a3: No account is required. You can check out as a guest. Creating an account lets you track orders and save details for next time.
orders.a4: Yes. All payments are processed through Shopify's secure, PCI-compliant checkout. We never store your payment details on our servers.

shipping.a1: Standard shipping within Portugal typically takes 2–4 business days. International orders usually arrive within 5–10 business days depending on destination.
shipping.a2: Yes! Orders over €50 qualify for free standard shipping within Portugal. International rates are calculated at checkout.
shipping.a3: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number by email so you can follow your delivery.
shipping.a4: Yes, we ship to many European countries and beyond. Shipping costs and estimated times are shown at checkout based on your location.

returns.a1: We accept returns on unworn items with tags attached within 14 days of delivery, in line with our conditions. Contact us first to start a return.
returns.q2: How do I return an item?
returns.a2: Contact us via email or WhatsApp with your order number and reason for return. We'll guide you through the process and provide a return label where applicable.
returns.q3: When will I receive my refund?
returns.a3: Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days after we receive and inspect the returned items. The amount is returned to your original payment method.
returns.q4: What if I received a damaged or wrong item?
returns.a4: We're sorry! Please contact us right away with a photo of the item and your order number. We'll arrange a replacement or full refund at no extra cost.

products.a1: We focus on women's summer fashion: swimwear (including bikinis), bags, jewelry, and related accessories — curated for women 18 and over.
products.q2: How do I choose the right size?
products.a2: Each product page includes sizing guidance. If you're between sizes or unsure, contact us — we're happy to help you find the best fit.
products.a3: We work with partners who share our values and prioritise responsible practices. Product pages note relevant details where available.
products.a4: Yes — message us via WhatsApp or email and we'll help you pair pieces or choose what flatters you best.
